issues.detail: The final montage uses both arrival on the sixth travel day and six days after departure, which can differ by one day. Evidence: u2212–u2224 establish an overnight stay before departure; u2245–u2246 say late afternoon on the sixth day; u2265 says six days after departure.

resolution.reason: The user explicitly chose: “Keep May 23: use the explicit sixth travel day and existing session date.” The inferred return journey is May 18–23 inclusive; session YAML remains unchanged.

transitions.label: Sheltering beneath the bridge
transitions.evidence: Session drStart anchors May 13; u0001 places the opening about an hour before noon, confirmed by u0094.
transitions.sourceText: Okay, it is perhaps an hour before noon, as the sun is steadily climbing in the sky and the heat of the day is starting to build to oppressive levels.

transitions.label: Northwestward ride
transitions.evidence: u0394–u0400 begin the ride to Havdar’s camp; u0413 says the remaining day covers roughly fifteen to twenty miles.

transitions.label: First camp at sunset
transitions.evidence: u0420 establishes the first night’s camp; u0486–u0490 and u0579 clarify that the sun is setting during the campsite discussion. These refer to the same camp, not successive evenings.
transitions.sourceText: So that first night you set camp.

transitions.label: First night’s watches
transitions.evidence: u0615–u0623: companions rest and Delwath watches the first half of the night.

transitions.label: First midnight passes
transitions.evidence: u0624: Delwath wakes Seeker just past midnight. Calendar date advances from the first camp on May 13.
transitions.sourceText: Until around just past midnight you go to wake Seeker.

transitions.label: Kenzo recovers; second travel day
transitions.evidence: u0650–u0656: everyone wakes after an uneventful night and Kenzo has recovered from the lingering effects of his death.
transitions.sourceText: and go to wake everybody in the morning, having passed an uneventful night.

transitions.label: Second camp and bird scouting
transitions.evidence: u0664–u0670: another thirty-mile day ends and the party makes camp at twilight.
transitions.sourceText: As the day comes to a close again you've traveled maybe another 30 miles putting you on within striking distance of reaching Havdar’s camp, the following evening ah 30.

transitions.label: Nighttime water collection
transitions.evidence: u0739–u0740 explicitly confirm it is night before Delwath and Seeker visit the nearby seep.

transitions.label: Ambush at the watch change
transitions.evidence: u0795–u0809: Delwath approaches Seeker around midnight and is attacked. u1552–u1554 place the end of this brief combat just past midnight; the calendar boundary falls within the ambush setup.
transitions.sourceText: To wake Seeker just just around midnight um.

transitions.label: After the ambush
transitions.evidence: u1554 explicitly places the aftermath just past midnight. The discussion, table break, and resumed watches in u1681–u1699 do not add another day.

transitions.label: Dawn after the ambush
transitions.evidence: u1699–u1707: the rest of the night passes and dawn rises; Delwath’s Strength returns.

transitions.label: Arrival at Havdar’s deserted camp
transitions.time: one or two hours after sunset
transitions.evidence: u1719–u1725: a full day of slower travel ends an hour or two after sunset at Havdar’s empty but intact camp.
transitions.sourceText: it's tiring it's you know the heat is is beating down during the heat of the day, but you push into the night i'm making good progress, and you know about an hour or two after sunset you come.

transitions.label: Tracks and the choice of destination
transitions.evidence: u1783–u1789: the camp’s evening passes without another attack, then morning dawns. Wellby examines Havdar’s recent tracks.

transitions.label: First day toward the stone house
transitions.evidence: u1902 establishes a two-day journey; u1905–u1906 say they set out and the first day passes uneventfully.

transitions.label: Second day toward the stone house
transitions.evidence: u1909–u1911 explicitly move to the next day, which also passes uneventfully.

transitions.label: Stone-house welcome
transitions.evidence: u1913–u1917: they approach Pava and Avaras’ house as the sun sets on that second day.
transitions.sourceText: As the sun is setting across the desert.

transitions.label: Overnight stay
transitions.evidence: u2212–u2224 confirm the overnight stay, Kenzo’s time with the Mystai, and Seeker’s stone-carving gift. No extra night is narrated.
transitions.sourceText: But just just you know, again I like I said we'd like spend the night.

transitions.label: Return journey begins
transitions.evidence: u2233–u2246 announce the return montage after the overnight stay. Departure on the following day, May 18, is inferred; arrival is on the sixth travel day.
transitions.sourceText: So, so, in the interest of time.

transitions.label: Return to Karawa
transitions.evidence: u2245–u2246 specify late-afternoon arrival on the sixth day; u2261–u2281 narrate the approach and welcome. The user chose May 23, retaining the current session end date, despite the later wording in u2265.
transitions.sourceText: You come up to the you know, to the to the red Mesa now looming above you stretching miles across the desert the largest feature around.
